subject: colext - site covariates change with year

messages.author: cbe647b083952ade
messages.subject: colext - site covariates change with year
parts:
Dear unmarked,

I have a brief question about colext. I read the colext vignette with 9 years of crossbill data and I noticed that the dataset includes 3 site covariates that are consistent among the nine years. The survey covariate (date) changes, but the site covariates do not.

My dataset has two primary periods (2 seasons within one year) with 3 surveys each. I have 9 detection covariates which change with each survey. I also have site covariates (12) which differ between the two seasons - they're not the same for each season (e.g. shallow_water1 and shallow_water2) as well as landscape variables that remain the same (e.g. floodplain_forest is not changing between seasons).

Is colext set up to handle site covariates that change with season or do they need to remain fixed? I know this functionality exists in PRESENCE, but I am testing it in colext and I'm not sure if my code is working - that is, that the estimates for season 1 occupancy would be modeled with season 1 site covariates, etc. I'm interested in how occupancy changes with changing habitat so I would like the first season and second season habitat to be considered during the first and second seasons respectively.

Thank you,
Sinead

Dear Sinead,
 There are "yearly-site covariates" which you can input into the unmarkedMultiFrame which I think will solve your problem. See the help file ?unmarkedMultFrame

regards
andy
